lessons.title: Class, main method and output.
lessons.explain: Everything lives in a class and execution starts at main. The compiler turns source into bytecode for the JVM.
lessons.exercise: Compile with javac, run with java, and print your name and age.

lessons.title: for and enhanced for.
lessons.explain: The enhanced for loop walks an array or collection. Types are explicit, so mistakes surface at compile time.
lessons.exercise: Sum an int array and print the average.

lessons.title: Fields, constructors, methods.
lessons.explain: A class defines fields and methods and a constructor builds an instance. this refers to the current object.
lessons.exercise: Add a speed field to Car and a method that increases it.

lessons.title: Collections with ArrayList.
lessons.explain: ArrayList is a resizable list of objects. The type in angle brackets says what it can hold.
lessons.exercise: Add five names to an ArrayList and print them in uppercase.

capstone: A library program with books, members and loans.
